summary: This note describes a miniseries about the Jackson family, with a cast list pairing actors with the real family members and figures they portray, including Joseph and Katherine Jackson and their children at different ages. It notes that the opening titles use real footage of the Jacksons and that the film is mostly based on Katherine Jackson's 1990 autobiography, My Family. The story is split into two parts: the first covers raising the children in Gary, Indiana and the early fame of The Jackson 5, and the second focuses on Michael Jackson's rise to solo stardom and his strained relationship with his father.
one_line: Cast and plot summary of the Jackson family miniseries, based mainly on Katherine Jackson's autobiography My Family.
key_facts: Lawrence Hilton - Jacobs plays Joseph Jackson, the Jacksons' patriarch.
Angela Bassett plays Katherine Jackson, the family matriarch.
Alex Burrall, Jason Weaver and Wylie Draper played Michael Jackson in different eras.
Bumper Robinson and Terrence Howard played Jackie Jackson in different eras.
Shakiem Jamar Evans and Angel Vargas played Tito Jackson.
Margaret Avery plays Katherine's mother Martha Scruse.
Holly Robinson Peete plays Diana Ross, and Billy Dee Williams plays Berry Gordy.
Vanessa L. Williams plays Suzanne de Passe.
The opening titles show footage of the real Jacksons rehearsing, performing on stage, and clips from the "Can You Feel It" music video.
The film is mostly based on the autobiography My Family, issued in 1990 by Katherine Jackson.
Part one covers how Joseph and Katherine raised their children first in Gary, Indiana, then dealt with The Jackson 5's early fame.
Part two covers Michael Jackson's struggles, including his brothers marrying early into The Jackson 5's success and his acne as a teenager.
Part two also covers Michael Jackson's solo success with the albums Off the Wall and Thriller.
Part two includes Michael Jackson's legendary Motown 25 performance of "Billie Jean" and his difficult relationship with his father.
